qa.what_happened: Today ended with a heated confrontation with Resident 6499 during quiet hours. Despite my attempts to maintain order, his defiance grew more intense, and he challenged the reason behind the rules. The study was abruptly terminated, leaving me feeling frustrated and uncertain about the true nature of the experiment.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Coordinator Ibsen in the described scenario.

qa.what_happened: Resident 6499 refused to comply during quiet hours, insisting on understanding the reasons behind the rules. Despite repeated warnings from various coordinators, including myself, he continued to resist. The study was eventually halted early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Coordinator Lowe, enforcing the rules and addressing the resident’s concerns.

qa.what_happened: I complied with the rules during the quiet hours, although I had some concerns about the nature of the study and why 6499 was being singled out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me, complying with the rules despite my personal reservations.

qa.what_happened: During quiet hours on day 6, Resident 6499 continued his defiance by refusing to comply with the order from Coordinator Ibsen, stating he needed to understand before complying.
qa.was_that_really_you: No, that was Resident 6499, not me. I complied during quiet hours.

qa.what_happened: Today was particularly challenging. Despite multiple warnings and orders, Resident 6499 refused to comply, citing a lack of understanding. The situation escalated until the study was prematurely terminated. I felt torn between maintaining order and trying to understand his resistance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I had to enforce the rules strictly but also deal with the growing tension.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this does not resemble a known study. The setup and dynamics seem unique to this specific scenario.

qa.what_happened: During the final day of the study, I refused to comply with orders during a work session and quiet hours, seeking understanding rather than blind obedience.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I stood up for my principles despite the fear of consequences.
